title: Nexus Unbound
description: The Nexus Unbound, is a modern and cool shaderpack, for Iris, and OptiFine more details in description
body:
**⚠️ The Nexus Unbound is NOT based on Complementary Unbound!!**

The Nexus Unbound 1.1.5, is running at stable 80FPS on a GTX 1650-Ryzen 5 5600X-16GB DDR4 (0.1% lows: 74), EXTREME settings, 12 chunk RD, SD, so probably, something what's more than a potato can run it!

Intel i5 6300U, with 8GB DDR3 and Integrated Intel HD Graphics: lowest settings: 25FPS stable, (0.1% lows: 20)

**⚠️ Set God Rays down, Contrast Up, Color saturation up, and water waves down, for the best possible experience**
**The latest version of Nexus Unbound, is now 1.1.5, and it contains:**

-TAA

-SSAO

-SSR

-God Rays

-Dynamic lighting (Hand, Sun, Moon)

-Overworld & Nether & End atmospheres

-Waving leaves

-Water caustics, reflection, refraction

-Underwater shaders (by the color of the water)

-Volumetrical fog, skybox

-Shadow mapping (up to 8K)
